intro: Mars 3 touched down in Terra Sirenum on December 2, 1971 — the first lander to survive Martian atmospheric entry and reach the surface, five days after sister Mars 2 crashed. Communications stopped after 14.5 seconds, returning a single partial degraded greyscale image fragment. The lander likely arrived in the middle of a planet-encircling dust storm. Mars 3's exact resting location is still debated; HiRISE imaged candidate hardware in 2013.
